evidence: minisvc/storage/repo.py:12-15 and :17-22 use a local SQLite file, with default relative path orders.sqlite from minisvc/config.py:10-13; no backup or migration mechanism exists
impact: Data may be written to an unexpected working-directory location and recovery/schema evolution are manual
mitigation: Require an explicit absolute/configured DB path, add migrations and backup/restore procedures, and test restart/recovery

evidence: minisvc/audit.py:4-10 returns an in-memory dict only; handlers.py:13 and :20 place events in responses; init_schema creates no audit table
impact: Audit events can be lost and cannot provide a durable history of creates and reads
mitigation: Persist audit records in a transactionally coordinated store and define retention/integrity requirements

evidence: minisvc/config.py:10-13 reads environment values with a relative default; cli.py:8-12 initializes schema but does not validate the path or enforce settings.readonly
impact: Deployment behavior varies with cwd, and the advertised readonly mode is ineffective
mitigation: Validate configuration at startup, use an explicit runtime data directory, and pass/enforce readonly policy in all write paths

impact: Missing fields or malformed values raise KeyError/ValueError; no domain constraints or consistent client errors are defined

evidence: minisvc/storage/repo.py:17-22 performs one SQLite insert with no retry, while README.md:7 claims two retries
impact: Transient lock or I/O failures can fail order creation immediately
mitigation: Define bounded retry/backoff for retryable SQLite errors and make error responses explicit; do not retry integrity violations
